thread:
incident-bot: Paging: High tail latency observed for hosted inference (text-gen) in us-west-2 after today's rollout. Alert INC-9876. P99 increased ~3x starting at 17:02 UTC. /ops/alerts/INC-9876 :rotating_light:

matt-eng: seeing the same. dashboards show p50 ~ stable, p95 up ~30%, p99 jumped to ~1.2s -> 3.8s. No error spike.

elaine-sre: digging into kernels and scheduling. I see repeated kernel fallback events on the canary pool and batching window growth for small requests. Logs show repeated eviction+reload of kv-cache on hosts 10.12.*.

oncall: @matt-eng @elaine-sre assigning myself. Priority: mitigate customer impact while we debug. Who can flip the rollout flag?

matt-eng: I can flip the feature flag for the canary. Hypothesis: new rollout changed batch_window default, causing larger cohort batching -> head-of-line + kernel fallback.

deploy-bot: Canary r-20260317-11 shifted 20% traffic at 17:02:15 UTC. Rollout manifest: model-serving v2.4.5, runtime-kernel v1.12.

elaine-sre: quick check: kernel fallback logs -> "kernel_swap: fallback to generic_attention_kernel at step X" repeated across multiple nodes. Also prefetch/pool eviction counters increasing.

oncall: mitigation plan: 1) disable canary traffic shift (kill-switch flag), 2) if latency persists rollback to previous runtime, 3) notify CS + customers as needed. I'll flip kill-switch now.

matt-eng: command I'm going to run:
```
./ctl rollout toggle --canary-id r-20260317-11 --enabled false --reason "latency spike"
```

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Toggling canary kill-switch...

deploy-bot: Canary r-20260317-11 disabled at 17:08:02 UTC. Traffic shifting back to stable.

sara-ops: metrics tail: p99 trending down already, 3.8s -> 2.0s within 2 minutes. Still above baseline (1.1s). CPU on affected GPUs spiked ~10% during rollback.

jack-pdx: CS check-in: any visible customer errors or rate-limited customers? We have one enterprise CUST-42 running high-traffic tests in us-west-2. Need heads-up if degraded.

matt-eng: no increased 5xxs. Throughput decreased slightly during the toggle, but returning now. I recommend a quick rollback of runtime-kernel v1.12 -> v1.11 on canary hosts while we root-cause batch_window change.

elaine-sre: Agreed. Kernel v1.12 seems to introduce a scheduling path that can fallback under certain seq-length distributions. Rolling runtime back for canary nodes only.

matt-eng: rollback command:
```
./deploy runtime rollback --pool canary-usw2 --target v1.11 --drain 10m --reason "regression v1.12"
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated at 17:12:40 UTC. Draining canary pool.

incident-bot: Note: Incident INC-9876 created. Severity: Sev2 (customer impact potential). Paging channel: #incidents. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/latency-tail-ops

sara-ops: after rollback start p99 down to 1.3s at 17:19. Approaching baseline. No customer-reported errors so far. CUST-42 reported slight improvement in their tests.

oncall: good. I'll open a short internal postmortem ticket and tag eng-ml + runtime. Immediate ask: preserve logs and kernel traces for the canary hosts. Do NOT rotate logs until we finish analysis.

matt-eng: capturing traces and saving artifacts to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-9876/traces.tar.gz

elaine-sre: quick root-cause notes: correlates to change in default batch_window param in rollout manifest (was supposed to be 8ms, shipped 80ms). That caused larger aggregation leading to kernel paths hitting fallback heuristics + kv eviction. Working on a config patch to harden batch_window validation.

jack-pdx: I'll notify CSMs with a short summary and that rollback mitigated impact; we'll follow up with customers later today.

customer-success: please include timeline and mitigation steps. Flag any customers showing increased latency so we can offer support.

oncall: Handoff to @elaine-sre for deeper RCA and monitoring overnight. Next on-call: @sara-ops 17:45 UTC handoff. If anything regresses, re-open INC-9876 and escalate to exec-ops.

elaine-sre: I'll pick up RCA. Key action items: 1) revert config change validation, 2) add kill-switch pre-checks on rollout for batch_window > 20ms, 3) add alert for kernel-fallback rate > 5/min.

matt-eng: I'll open PR to add validation and update rollout CI to catch this.

sara-ops: post-mitigation check (17:40 UTC): p99 stable @1.1s, p95 @230ms. Marking incident as mitigated.

incident-bot: INC-9876 status -> mitigated. Please fill incident postmortem template: https://incidents.redwood/templates/postmortem (assigned: elaine-sre, matt-eng). :white_check_mark:
